decision: Allocate a limited review budget to suspicious comment patterns without accusing legitimate participants.
primary_outcome: Adjudicated coordinated clusters discovered at a fixed review budget, alongside false flags on legitimate clusters.
denominator: All eligible docket comments for coverage, all reviewed clusters for precision; unsampled cases are not negatives.
independence_unit: Coordination cluster or docket; repeated messages from one cluster are dependent.
quality_guardrail: False accusations, protected legitimate participation and reviewer-hour budget.
minimum_data: Docket/comment IDs, sampling probabilities, cluster mapping, flag reason, independent adjudication and review effort.
failure_handling: Unreviewed comments retain unknown labels. Sampling-weighted population estimates require known inclusion probabilities and appropriate uncertainty.
release_rule: Use the detection ceiling only under its uniform-sampling and two-member-detection assumptions. Synthetic fixtures cannot authorize real enforcement.
reversal: Context review shows duplicates are legitimate, or the sampling design no longer matches the stated detection assumptions.
status: PROPOSED MEASUREMENT CONTRACT; NOT AN EXECUTED DOMAIN EXPERIMENT
defense: No. Duplication is a review signal and can reflect legitimate participation. The decision needs context and adjudication.
Why not report recall from reviewed comments?
The reviewed set is selected. Without labels or a defensible sampling design for the rest, population recall is unidentified.
